import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def powmod(base, exp):
    return pow(base, exp, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        print(powmod(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(powmod(p, p))
        return
    n = 1
    q = k
    while q != 1:
        q = (q * k) % p
        n += 1
    print(powmod(p, (p - 1) // n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
